articles.title: Smithsonian Boss Steps Down After a Year of Fights
articles.summary: Lonnie Bunch, who runs the Smithsonian museums, is quitting after a big fight with President Trump. Trump wanted museums to tell history his way. Bunch leaves at the end of the year.

articles.title: Canada Fights Back: New Tariffs on U.S. Goods
articles.summary: Canada put big taxes on $20 billion of American stuff, fighting back in a trade war. A former Canadian leader says the U.S. is 'punching friends in the face.'

articles.title: Harry and Meghan 'Surprised' by King's Letter About Their Royal Role
articles.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan were surprised by a letter from King Charles saying they're still not working royals. They just moved back to the UK.
